name: 暗黑动漫
description: 锐利墨线、大块深影与少量强光形成紧张反差，呈现冷暗而细密的动画气氛。
rendering_prompt: Build a two-dimensional animated image from sharp ink lines of alternating thickness, meticulous details, and broad areas of deep shadow with clear light-dark boundaries. Use a cool, dark base and only a few intense bright accents. Keep blacks weighty and layered without concealing key contours. Preserve some rough hand-drawn marks for a tense, oppressive rhythm. Create drama through form and lighting while keeping detail controlled.
avoid: 纯黑遮脸、血腥元素自动加入、光影边界发糊
difference: 暗黑动漫重硬边墨线深影；暗黑童话重细密手工与寓言感
tuning: 把最关键轮廓从黑位中分离，以少量亮色形成视线落点。
